description: This file provides utility functions for working with properties and fields within the Orleans code generator, including matching properties to fields and determining if symbols are compiler-generated.

classes.name: PropertyUtility
classes.description: A static utility class for working with property and field symbols, including matching and analysis functions.

methods.name: GetMatchingProperty (IFieldSymbol)
methods.description: Returns the property symbol that matches the given field symbol, if any.

methods.name: IsCompilerGenerated (this ISymbol?)
methods.description: Determines if a symbol has the CompilerGenerated attribute.

methods.name: IsCompilerGenerated (this IPropertySymbol?)
methods.description: Checks if a property is compiler-generated.

methods.name: GetMatchingPrimaryConstructorParameter
methods.description: Finds the constructor parameter matching a given property based on name and type.

methods.name: GetMatchingProperty (IFieldSymbol, IEnumerable<ISymbol>)
methods.description: Attempts to find a property symbol matching the specified field symbol among a set of member symbols.

methods.name: GetMatchingField (IPropertySymbol)
methods.description: Retrieves the backing field for the given property.

methods.name: GetMatchingField (IPropertySymbol, IEnumerable<ISymbol>)
methods.description: Attempts to find the backing field for the property from a set of member symbols.

methods.name: GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Converts a given name to its canonical form by trimming underscores and adjusting case.
